title: scene/vtc/graph types: omit default isAscending like EmailComparator
description: JMAP-18qe aligned the extension-types family (AGENTS.md Canonical Templates table: calendars, chat, contacts, filenode, sharing, tasks) to EmailComparator's #[serde(default = "bool_true", skip_serializing_if = "is_true")] on is_ascending. jmap-scene-types (src/query.rs x4), jmap-vtc-types (src/query.rs x3) and jmap-graph-types (src/query.rs x3, src/edit.rs x1) still use #[serde(default = "default_true")] and always emit isAscending:true. They are not listed in the types-family table, so decide whether they are siblings (and add them to the table) and mirror the change. Wire-conformant either way (RFC 8620 §5.5 default: true).
close_reason: Batch 21 (run wf_18048230-8ff): implemented, adversarially verified; CI green except new cargo-deny advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0387 (crypto-bigint 0.5.5, unrelated to these changes) at 741292f0; beqc spec commits 639dc1d/7787c51 in jmap-chat-spec (not pushed)
